liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (4 reviews): Reviewer rates this Other One the best in circulation; The Other One following the Mojo jam is described as bringing the house down [13][16][19][23]
- **Got My Mojo Workin'** (3 reviews): Jam flows into Mojo with Lee Oskar on harmonica, then continues into The Other One; Mojo is described as fun [16][22][23]
- **Stagger Lee** (2 reviews): Stagger Lee is a fine example of the song; Weir's slide playing nearly works, briefly; Reviewer lists Stagger Lee among the show's highlights [22][23]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Reviewer urges close listening to the Estimated Prophet into He's Gone sequence in the second set; Reviewer enjoys this Estimated Prophet for the flow of Garcia's playing [16][21]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha into Good Lovin' is called incredible, with beautiful group harmonies [20]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue is moving and overwhelming to this reviewer, even though the tape has a cut [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hamza el Din Song #1**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]
- **Hamza el Din Song #2**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]
- **Ollin Arrageed**: rare: 14 archived performances [24]
- **Got My Mojo Workin'**: back after 116 archived shows (547 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-10-21.mtx.seamons.94852.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 199 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1978-10-21.sbd.miller.89721.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [2]
- **gd1978-10-21.aud.rhinotrocity5.motb-0015.94600.flac24**: audience recording; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1978-10-21.166112.aud.remaster.acetboy.flac1644**: audience recording; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd78-10-21.sbd.popi.6100.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 190 min; rated 4.47/5 by 34 [8]. Said about its sound: Sound is good but somewhat thin [20]

## Around the show

- Turbaned musicians chanted and played traditional instruments with house lights up; lights dimmed and the Dead then came out [17]
- Reviewer found the band tight following their recent Egypt trip [19]
- Lee Oskar plays harmonica from Drums through Got My Mojo Workin' and Sugar Magnolia [2]
- Hamza El Din is credited with vocals and percussion [4]
- Reviewer has heard better Stella Blues than this one, despite others praising it [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-10-21.mtx.seamons.94852.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]. Also: Matrix mixing soundboard and audience, with all transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller, via DAT and Samplitude to FLAC; Audience portion taped on Maxell cassettes using two AKG d224e microphones into a Sony TC 158; Digital noise in I Need A Miracle was patched using shnid 6100; Stella Blue from 10:18 onward is also supplied [1]
- **gd1978-10-21.sbd.miller.89721.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Source is AKG D224E microphones to cassette master, then reel copies, transferred through MiniMe to CD; Patch material came from Pat Lee, recorded by Reinhart Holwein on a Sony TC-158 and transferred by Matt Smith [2]
- **gd1978-10-21.aud.rhinotrocity5.motb-0015.94600.flac24**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe and Jeff Thomas; source: 2 x AKG d224e => Sony TC 158 => 3 x Maxell UDXL II [3]. Also: Audience recording patched from the Miller source in He's Gone, Stella Blue and Sugar Magnolia [3]
- **gd1978-10-21.166112.aud.remaster.acetboy.flac1644**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by acetboy; source: This is a remaster of the Reinhart Hohlwein shn #94600 by acetboy [4]. Also: Remaster of shn 94600 replacing its three soundboard patches with a newly found alternate audience source, shn 102074; Patch taper stood on the floor under the mirrored ball, 20-25 feet from center stage, using a Nakamichi CR3A with Dolby [4]
- **gd78-10-21.sbd.popi.6100.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]
